Hi Support Team,

Forwarding email_029 from Roisin Moran (Apt 6B, Graylings) regarding repeated unauthorized parking in her allocated space B26. The offending vehicle is a black BMW 3 Series, reg 231-D-14582. This has happened three times this week. Roisin is pregnant and had to park far away today.

Urgency is medium. She requests identifying the vehicle owner, issuing a warning, and potentially clamping/towing. She also wants improved signage.

This requires human judgment to investigate the vehicle registration and determine ownership. We need to decide on appropriate enforcement action.

In parallel, we can acknowledge receipt to Roisin and assure her we're looking into it.

Recommended next step: Investigate vehicle registration 231-D-14582 and cross-reference with tenant database or visitor logs.

ManageCo AI Desk

Hi Roisin,

Thank you for bringing the parking issue in space B26 to our attention. We understand your frustration, especially given your current circumstances.

We are taking this matter seriously. We will investigate the ownership of the black BMW 3 Series with registration 231-D-14582 and issue a warning to the owner. We will also review the signage in the car park to ensure allocated spaces are clearly marked.

Should this continue, we will consider further action, including clamping or towing, as per our parking regulations. Please continue to document each instance with photos.

We appreciate you reporting this and will keep you updated on our progress.

ManageCo Property Management
